methodologyNotes: Roster of 9 drive-up automotive service ramps (oil-change / under-car work, not loading ramps or floor jacks) spanning foam, plastic, aluminum and steel construction from Race Ramps, RhinoGear/FloTool, BISupply, Scepter, Rage Powersports and the Discount Ramps house brand Black Widow. One draft entry (Nicky Nice 'Solid Steel Auto Ramp Set') was removed as unverifiable. Primary sources were manufacturer/reseller product pages (raceramps.com, discountramps.com) which rendered cleanly and confirmed prices and headline specs; major-retailer and marketplace listings (Amazon, AutoZone, Northern Tool, Walmart, Canadian Tire) plus the Algopix marketplace-aggregator spec sheet were used for cross-check. Several retailer pages (AutoZone, Northern Tool, Walmart, Canadian Tire) returned bot-detection/403 or timeouts at check time and could not be rendered; where a figure could not be independently confirmed it was set to null rather than asserted. Conventions: gvw_capacity_lb is the total published weight capacity for the set as sold (a pair); product_weight_lb is per single ramp except where noted (CR-7214 and ML-1066 publish only a set weight); lift_height_in and incline_angle_deg are in inches/degrees as published; boolean spec fields reflect explicitly marketed features and are null when the source is silent. All prices are current USD list/sale price found at check time (per-pair). accessedAt 2026-08-19.

products.priceNote: No verified current USD price; both retailer pages (Canadian Tire, US Walmart) were unrenderable (timeout / bot-detection) at check time.
